ModMetaData.name: Animal Gear - Null Outfit & Human Guard 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5 compatibility hotfix for Animal Gear. Player animals default to an animal-only None/无方案 outfit state. Animals with None do not run apparel optimization or search for apparel. Strict Animal-tagged apparel is also excluded from Humanlike wearability and starting-apparel generation, preventing animal equipment from spawning on people. Colonist outfit policies remain unchanged.
